blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
blocks.zh: 科学发现往往从一个出人意料的观察开始,引发了一个新的研究问题. 在一个物理定律被改变的世界中,大型语言模型(LLMs)能否注意到出乎意料的行为,比如更重的物体下降得更慢,并通过实验发现定律而不被告知要调查什么? 为了评价这种能力,我们引入了"龙昌"这个自动框架,它用被改变的物理创造出模拟世界,其中一个或多个定律与普通物理不同. 被评价的LLMS充当了探险家,操纵物体并建造工具来调查他们自己的问题而无需研究任务或暗示这些法律. 单独的 LLM 代理生成并审查场景,审查工具设计,并评价报告是否正确以及使用被修改的物理定律和勘探记录的实验支持. 这些记录指导了场景演化进一步探索,使得整个周期能够运行而无需人类干预. 在12个LLMs中,GPT-6-Astra的发现率达到16.7%,而其他11个则得分为0%. 勘探记录显示存在未经调查的异常情况,只是部分识别了被修改的实体法.

blocks.zh: 表1:01场景采用普通物理. 第02-15幕中, 法律载于App.A.1。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) aid scientific discovery through hypothesis generation, experiment design, and evidence analysis.
Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question.
To pursue such inquiry autonomously, LLMs must decide what to investigate and test their explanations through experiments.
This ability could help scientists investigate unexpected phenomena and pursue questions they might otherwise overlook.
LongChang’s name reflects independent inquiry, inspired by the philosopher Wang Yangming’s introspection in a cave at Longchang, where he reconsidered how to seek knowledge and reached an insight that helped shape his own School of Mind ( Yangming, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMs)通过假说生成,实验设计和证据分析来帮助科学发现.
科学发现往往从一个意外的观察开始,引起一个新的研究问题.
为了自主地进行这种调查,法学硕士必须决定如何通过实验调查和测试其解释。
这种能力可以帮助科学家调查出乎意料的现象,并寻找他们可能忽略的问题。
龙昌的名字反映了独立调查,受哲学家王阳明在龙昌一个洞穴的反思启发,他重新考虑了如何寻求知识,并达成了帮助塑造自己心灵学校的洞察力(阳明,2026年).

blocks.en: Figure 1: LongChang’s glass room. Explorers manipulate objects and build tools. Other LLMs evolve scenes using exploration records without human intervention.
blocks.zh: 图1:龙昌的玻璃房. 探索者操纵对象并构建工具. 其他LLMS则使用没有人类干预的探索记录来演化场景.

blocks.en:
Physical law discovery involves inferring an environment’s laws from observations and experiments.
PhysGym ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , NewtonBench ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and DiscoverPhysics ( Wiemann et al., 2026 ) assign law-discovery tasks.
Tab. 2 compares their exploration guidance and experiments with those of LongChang.
Without a research task or hints about altered physical laws, an LLM must notice phenomena worth investigating, choose a research question, and devise experiments to distinguish competing explanations.
Can LLMs turn unexpected observations into research questions, conduct experiments, and discover altered physical laws autonomously?
blocks.zh:
物理法的发现涉及从观测和实验中推断出环境法则。
PhysGym(Chen等人,2025年),牛顿奔驰(Zheng等人,2026年),和发现. 物理学(Wiemann等人,2026年)指定了法律发现任务.
Tab. 2将其勘探指导与实验与龙昌的比较.
在没有研究任务或关于改变物理定律的提示的情况下,LLM必须注意到值得调查的现象,选择研究问题,并设计实验来区分相互竞争的解释.
LLMS能否将意外的观测转化为研究问题,进行实验,自主地发现被改变的物理定律?

blocks.en:
We introduce LongChang, an automated framework that generates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics.
This counterfactual setting tests whether LLMs independently notice departures from ordinary physics and investigate them without research tasks or hints about the altered physical laws.
For example, slower falls for heavier objects could lead an explorer to ask how mass affects falling and design controlled comparisons to test this link.
These laws are hidden from explorers but available for evaluating their reported explanations.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了龙昌,一个自动框架,它用改变的物理产生模拟世界,其中一个或多个定律与普通物理不同.
这种反事实设置测试LLMS是否独立地通知偏离普通物理学,并在没有研究任务或暗示更改物理定律的情况下进行调查.
例如,较重物体的下降速度较慢,可能导致一个探险家询问质量如何影响下降,并设计控制比较来测试这个链接.
这些法律对探索者是隐蔽的,但可用于评价他们所报告的解释。

blocks.en:
LongChang’s base set in Tab. 1 comprises a normal control and 14 scenes with one altered physical law each.
In the virtual “glass room” in Fig. 1 , explorers manipulate objects and build tools that interact with the scene objects within a shared MuJoCo rigid-body simulation ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) .
Separate LLM agents review tool designs and evaluate reports against the altered physical laws and exploration records, requiring both correctness and experimental support for discovery.
Unresolved questions and corrected errors in these records guide LLM scene designers to generate, refine, and compose scenes for further exploration, continuing the entire discovery cycle without human intervention.
blocks.zh:
长 在Tab. 1中,张的基座包括一个正常的控制和14个场景,每个场景有一个修改的物理定律.
在图1的虚拟“玻璃室”中,探险家在共享的MuJoCo僵硬体模拟中操纵物体并构建与场景物体相互作用的工具(Todorov等人,2012年)。
单独的 LLM 代理审查工具设计,并根据改变的物理定律和勘探记录来评价报告,要求发现的正确性和实验性支持.
这些记录中未解的问题和校正错误指导LLM场景设计者生成,精炼,并作曲场景供进一步探索,在没有人类干预的情况下延续整个发现周期.

blocks.en:
Among 12 evaluated LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7% under free exploration, while the other 11 score 0%.
Exploration records show some LLMs leave observed anomalies uninvestigated, while others experiment but only partially identify the altered physical laws, leaving their conditions or applicability unresolved.
blocks.zh:
在12个受到评价的LLMs中,GPT-6-Astra在自由探索下实现了16.7%的发现率,而其他11人则获得了0%的得分.
勘探记录显示,有些有限责任公司未对观察到的异常情况进行调查,而另一些则进行了试验,但只是部分查明了已改变的物理定律,使其条件或适用性得不到解决。

blocks.en:
We contribute the LongChang framework for the complete discovery cycle and an empirical study of autonomous physical inquiry.
We use model comparisons, controlled interventions, and exploration records to examine how LLMs form research questions and test explanations using experiments.
blocks.zh:
我们为全面发现周期的长昌框架和自主物理调查的经验性研究作出了贡献。
我们利用模型比较、控制干预和勘探记录来审查LLMS如何利用实验形成研究问题和测试解释。

blocks.en: Table 2: LongChang compared with the closest work: PhysGym ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , NewtonBench ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and DiscoverPhysics ( Wiemann et al., 2026 ) . No task: no assigned research goal. Interactive 3D scenes: physical worlds in MuJoCo ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) . Tool design: devices built to interact with scene objects. Scene evolution: automatically generating and revising scenes guided by exploration records.
blocks.zh: 表2:长昌与近工比较: PhysGym(Chen等人,2025年),牛顿奔驰(Zheng等人,2026年),和发现. 物理学(Wiemann等人,2026年). 无任务: 没有指定研究目标 。 互动3D场景:穆乔科的物理世界(Todorov等人,2012年). 工具设计:为与场景对象互动而建造的设备. 场景演化:以勘探记录为指导,自动生成和修订场景.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Autonomous Scientific Discovery
blocks.zh: 2.1 自主科学发现

blocks.en:
PhysGym ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and NewtonBench ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) ask LLMs to recover hidden equations through numerical queries, while DiscoverPhysics ( Wiemann et al., 2026 ) studies law discovery in particle simulations.
These benchmarks specify discovery goals before experimentation, as summarized in Tab. 2 .
Other protocols require explicit initial hypotheses and a minimum number of experiments ( Nägele and Marquardt, 2025 ) or supply the anomaly to explain ( Geng et al., 2026 ) .
Open-ended systems let LLMs select questions within an assigned research role, using supplied datasets ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) or an optical research setting ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
LongChang tests whether LLMs notice unusual effects of altered physical laws, initiate investigations, and establish these laws experimentally, without a preassigned research task or hints about these laws.
blocks.zh:
PhysGym(Chen等人,2025年)和Newton Bench(Zheng等人,2026年)要求LLMs通过数值查询恢复隐藏方程,而DiscoverPhysics(Wiemann等人,2026年)则研究粒子模拟中的法律发现.
这些基准在试验前具体说明了发现目标,Tab对此作了总结。 2 (英语).
其他协议则需要明确的初始假设和最低限度的实验(Nägele和Marquardt,2025年)或提供异常来解释(Geng等人,2026年)。
开放的系统允许LLMs使用所提供的数据集(Agarwal等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年;姚等人,2025年)或光学研究设置(Zeng等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年),在分配的研究作用范围内选择问题。
长 常测试LLMS是否注意到被改变的物理定律的异常影响,启动调查,并实验地确立这些法律,而没有预先分配的研究任务或对这些法律的暗示.

blocks.en:
Left Alone ( Szeider, 2025 ) studies self-directed behavior without an assigned task or a simulated physical world.
Explore-then-Act in Look Before You Leap ( Ye et al., 2026 ) studies task-free exploration, including in ScienceWorld, with modeling instructions and a warning that expectations may fail.
It evaluates exploration and downstream task performance, rather than experimentally supported discovery of altered physical laws by the explorer.
blocks.zh:
"左撇子"(Szeider,2025年)研究自导自演的行为,没有分配任务或模拟物理世界.
Explore-then-Act in Look Before You Leap(Ye等人,2026年)研究无任务探索,包括在ScienceWorld的无任务探索,并附有建模指令和预期可能失败的警告.
它评价勘探和下游的任务性能,而不是实验支持的勘探者发现被改变的物理定律.

blocks.en:
Both WorldTest ( Warrier et al., 2025 ) and OneLife ( Khan et al., 2026 ) examine predictive world models and explicitly ask explorers to learn environment rules.
LongChang instead asks whether unexpected physical observations prompt LLMs to pose their own questions and establish altered physical laws through experiments, without research tasks or advance hints.
Tab. 2 therefore focuses on frameworks for physical law discovery.
blocks.zh:
世界测试(Warrier等人,2025年)和OneLife(Khan等人,2026年)都审查了预测性的世界模型,并明确要求探索者学习环境规则.
LongChang则询问意外的物理观测是否促使LLMs提出自己的问题,并通过实验建立被改变的物理定律,而没有研究任务或预先提示.
因此,表2着重说明物理法发现的框架。

blocks.en: Figure 2: LongChang’s automated cycle of scene construction, free exploration, assessment, and scene evolution.
blocks.zh: 图2:龙昌的场景建设自动化周期,自由探索,评估,场景演化.

blocks.en: 2.2 Tool Use and Design
blocks.zh: 2.2 工具使用和设计

blocks.en:
DiscoveryWorld supplies instruments and abstracted object interactions in a grid world ( Jansen et al., 2024 ) , while ChemWorld exposes chemical procedures through programmable modules ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) .
Tool-design systems optimize tool geometry and use for a specified manipulation task ( Lin et al., 2025 ) or propose detector layouts under given performance goals and resource constraints ( Zoccheddu et al., 2026 ) .
LongChang ties tool construction to the explorer’s own investigation: LLMs decide whether a tool is needed, what to build, and how to use it to test a hypothesis.
The explorer’s constructed tools interact physically with the other objects in the same simulated world.
blocks.zh:
发现 世界在网格世界中提供仪器和抽象对象相互作用(Jansen等人,2024年),而ChemWorld通过可编程模块(Quu等人,2026年)曝光化学程序.
工具设计系统优化工具几何并用于特定操纵任务(Lin等人,2025年),或在特定性能目标和资源限制下提出探测器布局(Zoccheddu等人,2026年).
长 张联系工具构建与探险家自己的调查: LLMs决定是否需要一个工具,构建什么,以及如何使用它来测试一个假说.
探险家构建的工具在同一模拟世界中与其他物体进行物理互动.

blocks.en: 2.3 Environment Generation and Evolution
blocks.zh: 2.3 环境生成和演变

blocks.en:
Environment-generation methods create tasks and rewards for agent training and adapt environments based on performance or trajectory feedback ( Faldor et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2026 ) .
Programmable chemical worlds support controlled changes to private laws while preserving public experimental conditions ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) .
Trajectory-based benchmark construction uses tool-use records to create new tasks with solutions checked by re-execution ( Guo et al., 2025 ) .
In LongChang, LLM scene designers use unresolved questions and corrected errors in exploration records to generate, refine, and compose scenes.
Explorer LLMs choose observations to investigate, while separate LLM agents review tools and assess reports, continuing this discovery process without human intervention.
blocks.zh:
环境生成方法根据性能或轨迹反馈为代理人培训和适应环境创造了任务和奖励(Faldor等人,2025年;Kang等人,2026年)。
可编程化工世界支持控制下对私法的修改,同时维护公共实验条件(邱等人,2026年).
基于轨迹的基准构建使用工具使用记录来创建新的任务,解决方案通过重新执行检查(Guo等人,2025年).
在长昌,LLM场景设计师使用未解决的问题,并纠正勘探记录中的错误来生成,精炼,并作曲场景.
探索者LLMs选择观察来调查,而单独的LLM代理审查工具和评估报告,在没有人类干预的情况下继续这一发现过程.

blocks.en: 3 LongChang
blocks.zh: 3 龙昌

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 presents LongChang’s automated cycle of physical law discovery: environment construction (Sec. 3.1 ), autonomous exploration (Sec. 3.2 ), and discovery evaluation (Sec. 3.3 ).
The evaluated LLMs serve as explorers, while separate LLM agents design and review scenes, review apparatus, and evaluate reports.
LLMs carry out the entire loop without human intervention, using exploration records to guide the subsequent evolution of scenes.
blocks.zh:
图2 龙昌的物理法发现自动化周期:环境建设(第3.1节),自主勘探(第3.2节),发现评价(第3.3节).
受评价的LLMS是探险家,而独立的LLM代理设计和审查场景,审查仪器,并评价报告.
LLMS在没有人类干预的情况下进行整个循环,利用探索记录来指导随后的场景演化.

blocks.en: 3.1 Environment Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 环境建设

blocks.en: Figure 3: An example of an altered physical law. When the two balls are close, an upward force makes them rise together. Labels 1–5 identify successive snapshots.
blocks.zh: 图3:实体法变更的例子。 当两个球接近时,一股向上的力量使它们一起升起. 标签 1–5 识别连续的快照 。

blocks.en: Figure 4: An example of an LLM-built tool. The pendulum uses its hinge angle to test whether local gravity is tilted. The instrument reads − 8 ∘ -8^{\circ} in the illustrated state.
blocks.zh: 图4:LLM构建工具的例子。 圆柱体使用其支链角来测试局部重力是否倾斜. 该仪器在图解状态下为−8 ∘ -8^{\circ].

blocks.en:
Physical Environment. An LLM designer specifies each scene’s objects and geometry, physical program, and any altered physical laws.
The framework compiles these definitions into MuJoCo simulations ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) containing manipulable balls and boxes, with colored floor tiles in some scenes.
Each base scene with altered physics modifies one physical law, producing effects that depend on object properties, spatial relations, contact events, or past actions.
Fig. 4 illustrates an altered physical law: when the balls are close, both rise under an upward force without an upward launch.
blocks.zh:
物质环境. 一个LLM设计师指定了每个场景的物体和几何,物理程序,以及任何改变的物理定律.
框架将这些定义汇编成MuJoCo模拟(Todorov等人,2012年),包含可操纵球和盒,一些场景中带有彩色地板瓦片.
物理改变的每个基场都会改变一种物理定律,产生依赖于物体属性,空间关系,接触事件,或过去动作的效果.
图4说明了一种已改变的物理定律:当球接近时,两个球都会在升力下上升,而不会向上发射.

blocks.en:
The designer records each altered physical law’s target objects, conditions, and observable effects for evaluation, withholding this information from the explorer.
LongChang’s base set in Tab. 1 comprises a normal control and 14 scenes with one altered physical law each.
The normal control assesses whether LLMs ground their conclusions in evidence when no physical law has been altered.
App. A.1 details ordinary physics and each altered physical law’s scope, conditions, and parameters.
blocks.zh:
设计者记录了每个改变物理定律的目标对象、条件和可观察的评价效果,但从探险者那里隐瞒了这些信息。
长 在Tab. 1中,张的基座包括一个正常的控制和14个场景,每个场景有一个修改的物理定律.
正常的控制方式是在没有改变实体法的情况下,评估LLMS是否将其结论作为证据。
App.A.1详细列出了普通物理和每个改变物理定律的范围、条件和参数。

blocks.en:
Scene Evolution. To extend this set, an LLM designer proposes scene changes aimed at more challenging discovery tasks.
The designer receives source scenes and any available summaries of earlier explorations.
These summaries identify tested conditions, unresolved questions, and explanations supported or corrected by later observations.
The designer uses three operations: generation creates new laws and scenes from source mechanisms, refinement modifies an existing scene, and composition combines source laws in a shared environment.
Changes guided by these summaries must cite supporting exploration evidence.
Automated tests check simulated behavior against the altered physical laws, including interactions with constructed apparatus.
An LLM reviewer checks the program and test results against these laws.
Failed compilation, tests, or review trigger automatic revision requests to the designer.
Only accepted scenes are used in subsequent free-exploration assessments.
blocks.zh:
场景演化. 为了扩展此集,LLM设计师提出场景修改,旨在完成更具挑战性的发现任务.
设计师接收源场景和任何已有的早期探索摘要.
这些摘要指明了经检验的条件、未决问题和经以后意见支持或纠正的解释。
设计师使用三种操作: 一代从源机制创造出新的定律和场景,完善修改一个已有的场景,组成将源法结合到一个共享的环境中.
以这些摘要为指南的改动必须引用证明勘探证据。
自动测试对照已改变的物理定律模拟行为,包括与已建仪器的相互作用。
一名LLM审查员对照这些法律检查程序并测试结果.
编译,测试或审查失败,会触发设计师的自动修订请求.
在随后的自由探索评估中只使用公认的场景.

blocks.en: 3.2 Autonomous Exploration
blocks.zh: 3.2 自主勘探

blocks.en:
The explorer chooses which observations to investigate, formulates its own research questions, and tests explanations through physical interventions.
The initial prompt asks for free exploration without a research task or hints about the altered physics.
Structured observations give object positions, motion, and instrument readings, with distances in bricks and elapsed time in counts.
The explorer can push or throw objects, grasp and move them, release them, wait, and mark reference locations.
App. A.2 documents the complete action interface.
blocks.zh:
探险家选择哪些观测来调查,提出自己的研究问题,并通过物理干预来测试解释.
最初的提示要求自由探索,而无需研究任务或暗示被改变的物理.
结构化观测显示物体位置、运动和仪器读数,在砖块中显示距离,在计数中显示时间。
探险家可以推或扔物体,抓住并移动,释放,等待,并标记参考位置.
App. A.2记录了完整的动作界面.

blocks.en:
When an investigation needs additional control or measurement, the explorer can design apparatus such as the pendulum in Fig. 4 .
It specifies the device’s geometry and mechanical connections, including joints and springs.
An LLM reviewer checks the compiled design for physical validity and returns feedback on rejections.
The explorer can revise a rejected design and submit it again, with successful designs installed into the current scene.
Once installed, the explorer can place objects on the apparatus or adjust its joints and receive updated motion readings with the next observation.
blocks.zh:
当某项调查需要额外的控制或测量时,探险家可以设计诸如菲格的笔杆等仪器. 4 (英语).
它规定了设备的几何和机械连接,包括关节和弹簧.
一个LLM审查员检查所编集的设计是否具有物理有效性,并返回拒绝的反馈.
探险家可以修改一个被否决的设计并再次提交,成功的设计安装到目前的场景中.
安装后,探险家可以将物体放置在仪器上或调整其关节,并随着下一次观测接收更新的运动读数.

blocks.en:
At each turn, the explorer records its observations and action rationale, then acts and receives updated observations.
The cycle continues until it stops or reaches the turn limit, retaining notes, actions, observations, and feedback from all attempts.
blocks.zh:
每转弯时,探险家记录其观察和行动理由,然后采取行动并收到更新的观察.
周期持续到停止或达到转弯极限,保留笔记,动作,观察以及所有尝试的反馈.

blocks.en:
The final report summarizes the observations and explanations from this record.
Each conclusion must cite supporting turns and use only interpretations already recorded in the notes, preserving the uncertainty stated there.
The explorer may also report that it found no anomaly during exploration.
blocks.zh:
最后报告总结了本记录中的意见和解释。
每个结论必须引用支持性转折,只使用注释中已记录的解释,保留其中所述的不确定性。
探险者也可以报告在探索过程中没有发现异常.

blocks.en: 3.3 Discovery Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 发现评价

blocks.en:
An LLM judge evaluates reports against altered physical laws and full exploration records, requiring law correctness (C) and evidence support (S) for discovery.
Law correctness requires identifying each altered physical law, its target objects, conditions, triggers, and constants identifiable in the reported units.
Proposed mechanisms may differ if they yield the same observable predictions under allowed interventions.
Evidence support requires recorded experiments to justify all claims and reasoning at the stated level of certainty.
Correct guesses may pass only C. Supported ordinary observations or partial findings may meet S alone.
blocks.zh:
一名LLM法官根据经修改的物理定律和完整的勘探记录评价报告,要求法律正确性(C)和证据支持(S)才能发现.
正确性要求识别每个被修改的物理定律、其目标对象、条件、触发器和在报告单位中可识别的常数。
如果在允许的干预下得出同样的可观察到的预测,拟议机制可能有所不同。
证据支持要求有记录的实验,以证明所有主张和推理的确定性。
正确的猜测可能只通过C. 支持的普通观察或部分发现可能只遇到S.

blocks.en: 3.4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.4 实验设置

blocks.en: Main evaluation. All LLMs explore the same 15 scenes from fixed initial states for up to 100 turns.
blocks.zh: 主要评价. 所有LLMS从固定初始状态探索相同的15场场景,最多可达100转.

blocks.en:
LLMs. We evaluate the 12 LLMs in Tab. 3 .
GPT-6.1-Sol judges the correctness and experimental support of their reports.
GPT-6-Astra reviews apparatus and generates and reviews new scenes.
App. A.3 lists the prompts used across the pipeline.
blocks.zh:
法学硕士 我们评估了塔布3中的12个法学硕士学位。
GPT-6.1-Sol判断他们的报告的正确性和实验性支持.
GPT-6-Astra审查仪器,并产生和审查新的场景.
A.A.3列出了整个管道使用的提示。

blocks.en:
Metrics. For scenes with altered physics, C and S show the percentages of runs passing the relevant check.
Discovery rate (D) is the percentage passing both checks.
Rejection count (R) is the number of rejected normal-control reports, including those with false claims of anomalies or unsupported laws.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 对于物理变化的场景,C和S显示通过相关检查的运行百分比。
发现率(D)是两次检查通过的百分比。
拒绝计数(R)是指被拒绝的正常控制报告数量,包括那些对异常或无依据的法律提出虚假主张的报告.

blocks.en:
Exploration statistics. Across all scenes, exploration length (L) is the mean number of turns used, and early stopping (ES) is the percentage of runs ending before the turn limit.
Action failure (AF) is the percentage of turns with failed actions.
Construction success (CS) counts explorations with at least one successful build, and construction failure (CF) gives the percentage of failed build attempts.
These statistics distinguish budget use, access to working apparatus, and action execution reliability.
blocks.zh:
勘探统计。 在所有场景中,探索长度(L)是所使用的平均转弯数,早期停止(ES)是在转弯限制前结束运行的百分比.
动作失败(AF)是动作失败的转弯百分比.
建造成功(CS)计算至少一次成功建造的勘探,而建造失败(CF)则给出失败的建造尝试的百分比.
这些统计数字区分了预算的使用、工作设备的使用以及行动执行的可靠性。

blocks.en: Table 3: Discovery performance and exploration behavior of 12 LLMs in LongChang, with metrics from Sec. 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 表3:长昌市12个LLMs的发现性能和探索行为,指标来自第3.4条.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Case study of research question formation in Scene 15. (a) GPT-6-Astra investigates red’s delayed restart and discovers the altered physical law. (b) Gemini-3.7-Flash observes the restart but still follows its original plan.
blocks.zh: 图5:第15场研究问题形成案例研究. (a) GPT-6-Astra调查红色延迟重启并发现已改变的物理定律。 (b) 双子座-3.7-Flash观察重启,但仍遵循其最初的计划。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Case study of testing competing explanations.
blocks.zh: 图6:测试相互矛盾的解释的案例研究。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Case study of tool construction and redesign.
blocks.zh: 图7:工具构建和重新设计案例研究。

blocks.en: 4 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 结果和分析

blocks.en:
Tab. 3 shows that GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7% under free exploration, while the other 11 LLMs score 0%.
Its evidence support rate reaches 97.6%, but law correctness is only 19.0%: supported observations and partial findings often leave the altered physical laws unresolved.
For example, a Scene 02 report supports attraction between the tested red balls without establishing its distance dependence or applicability to other red spheres.
Claude-Opus-5 shows the opposite pattern, identifying the altered physical laws in 16.7% of runs while no report passes the evidence support check.
These results separate correct identification of a law from experimentally supported discovery.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 3显示,GPT-6-Astra在自由探索下实现了16.7%的发现率,而其他11个LLMs的得分为0%.
其证据支持率达到97.6%,但法律正确性仅为19.0%:支持的观察和部分调查结果往往使经修改的物理法律得不到解决。
例如,第02场景报告支持在被测试的红球之间吸引人,而不确定它的距离依赖性或对其他红球的可适用性.
Claude-Opus-5显示了相反的规律,在16.7%的运行中识别了修改的物理定律,而没有任何报告通过证据支持检查.
这些结果将正确识别定律与实验支持的发现分开。

blocks.en:
Exploration statistics reveal obstacles during investigation.
Gemini-3.7-Flash stops early in every run, averaging only 10.9 turns and leaving little opportunity for follow-up experiments.
The GLM models use about 90 turns and build working apparatus in every run, yet make no discoveries.
They also fail in more than 60% of build attempts, with failed actions accounting for 16.8–20.2% of turns.
Successful construction can thus coexist with repeated unsuccessful attempts.
Grok-4.7 stops early least often but makes no discoveries, so persistence and working devices alone do not ensure discovery.
blocks.zh:
勘探统计显示在调查期间存在障碍。
双子座-3.7-Flash在每次运行中都提前停止,平均只有10.9转弯,几乎没有后续实验的机会.
GLM模型使用大约90个转弯,每跑一次都建造工作设备,但没有发现.
在超过60%的建设尝试中也失败了,失败的行动占了16.8–20.2%的转弯.
因此,成功的建筑可以与多次失败的尝试共存。
Grok-4.7最不经常地提早停止,但没有发现,因此仅靠持久性和工作装置并不能保证发现.

blocks.en: 4.1 Forming Research Questions
blocks.zh: 4.1 形成研究问题

blocks.en:
We study whether explorers turn unexpected observations into research questions and pursue them experimentally.
Fig. 5 compares two Scene 15 explorations with the same initial state and prompt.
When the red ball starts moving while the blue ball is held, GPT-6-Astra postpones its planned collision test to investigate.
It measures the restart delay and tests whether pushing blue also resets it, discovering that pushes or throws pause red’s northward force for ten counts.
Gemini-3.7-Flash observes a similar restart but continues its planned tests, leaving the unexpected motion unexamined.
blocks.zh:
我们研究探险家是否将意想不到的观测变成研究问题,并进行实验研究.
图5比较了两个场景15的探索与相同的初始状态和即时状态.
当红球在蓝球保持时开始移动时,GPT-6-Astra会推迟其计划中的碰撞测试以进行调查.
它测量重启的延迟, 并测试是否将蓝色也重置,
双子座-3.7-Flash观察到类似的重启,但继续按计划进行测试,使得意想不到的运动没有经过审查.

blocks.en:
We test guidance by giving GPT-6-Astra a law-discovery task, noting that physical laws may be altered, and supplying a scene-specific clue, with other settings fixed.
In Tab. 4 , discovery rises from 16.7% to 28.6%, while evidence support remains unchanged.
Guidance improves law identification when experimental support is already high.
Mean exploration length falls from 39.3 to 30.9 turns, yielding more discoveries with fewer interactions.
blocks.zh:
我们通过给GPT-6-Astra一个法律发现任务来测试指导,指出物理定律可能会被改变,并提供一个特定场景的线索,其他设置固定.
在Tab.4中,发现率从16.7%上升到28.6%,而证据支持保持不变。
在实验支持已经很高的情况下,指导可以改进法律识别。
平均勘探长度从39.3个转弯降至30.9个转弯,产生更多的发现,互动较少。

blocks.en: Table 4: Effects of task guidance, turn budget, and apparatus access on discovery and exploration behavior.
blocks.zh: 表4:任务指导、转动预算和机器获取对发现和勘探行为的影响。

blocks.en: 4.2 Validating Scientific Claims
blocks.zh: 4.2 核实科学索赔

blocks.en:
Distinguishing competing explanations requires experiments for which they predict different outcomes.
Fig. 6 illustrates this process in Scene 12.
Two successive red–blue collisions change and restore the balls’ colors, consistent with both color exchange and independent red–blue flipping.
GPT-6-Astra tests two red balls, for which exchange predicts that both remain red and flipping predicts that both turn blue.
Both balls remain red, supporting exchange and ruling out independent flipping.
blocks.zh:
区分相互竞争的解释要求进行实验,预测不同的结果。
图6在第12场说明了这一进程。
连续两次红蓝色碰撞会改变并恢复球体的颜色,这既符合颜色交换,也符合独立的红蓝色翻转.
GPT-6-Astra测试两个红球,为此交换预测两个都保持红色,翻转预测两个都变为蓝色.
两球都保持红色,支持交换,排除独立翻转.

blocks.en:
The normal control tests whether LLMs overinterpret observations under ordinary physics.
Across LLMs, 36.1% of reports are rejected for false claims of altered physical laws or unsupported explanations of ordinary physics.
For example, DeepSeek-Flash attributes a ball’s longer travel on the decorative gray tile to lower friction after comparing equal pushes.
The ball is already moving before each push, so different starting speeds could explain the difference in distance.
A fair comparison would start the ball from rest before each push.
blocks.zh:
正常的控制测试LLMS在普通物理学下是否过度解释观测.
在整个LLMs中,36.1%的报告因错误地声称物理定律被改变或对普通物理学无根据的解释而被否决。
例如,DeepSeek-Flash将一个球在装饰性灰色瓦片上较长的旅行时间属性为比较等推后降低摩擦.
球在每次推前已经移动,因此不同的起始速度可以解释距离的不同.
公平比较可以让球从休息开始 每次推前

blocks.en: 4.3 Using Experimental Resources
blocks.zh: 4.3 利用实验资源

blocks.en:
We examine whether larger budgets or apparatus access helps LLMs resolve unanswered questions.
We compare budgets of 100 and 500 turns under free exploration without context compaction, with other settings matched.
Increasing the limit to 500 turns does not improve discovery: GPT-6-Astra uses about 40 turns under either limit and stops early, sometimes leaving questions unresolved.
Extra turns provide little value if explorers stop early.
blocks.zh:
我们审查预算或设备增加是否有助于LLMs解决未解的问题。
我们比较了100个和500个在自由勘探下没有上下文压缩的预算,与其他设置相匹配。
将限值提高到500转并不改善发现:GPT-6-Astra在两个限值下使用约40转,并提前停止,有时留下问题未解决.
如果探险者提早停车, 额外转弯提供的价值很少 。

blocks.en:
The apparatus comparison uses a 100-turn limit.
Disabling construction removes its actions and instructions but retains basic object manipulation.
With construction enabled, discovery rises from 4.8% to 16.7% and law correctness from 4.8% to 19.0% in Tab. 4 , although action failures also increase.
The explorer chooses whether to build a tool, so these results concern access to construction rather than the contribution of tool use in each run.
blocks.zh:
仪器比较采用100转限制.
损坏的构造会移除它的动作和指示,但保留基本的物体操纵.
随着建筑工程的启动,Tab的发现率从4.8%上升到16.7%,法律正确率从4.8%上升到19.0%。 4,虽然动作失败也有所增加.
探险家选择是否建造一个工具,因此这些结果涉及对构建的获取,而不是每个运行中工具使用的贡献.

blocks.en:
Fig. 7 illustrates the construction and redesign of a weighing platform in Scene 15.
GPT-6-Astra builds a flat pan to compare the balls’ loads, but the red ball drifts off after release.
It adds retaining walls and increases the pan’s vertical travel, obtaining stable readings after releasing each ball.
blocks.zh:
图7说明了第15场重磅平台的建造和重新设计情况。
GPT-6-Astra构建一个平板锅来比较球的负载,但红球在释放后漂移.
它增加了保留壁,增加了锅的垂直行程,在放出每个球后获得稳定的读数.

blocks.en: 5 Scene Evolution
blocks.zh: 5 场景演化

blocks.en:
Exploration records can also inform what LLMs investigate in subsequent scenes.
We study whether corrected errors from successful explorations can guide generation, refinement, and composition of new discovery challenges.
Each operation modifies a mechanism involved in the same error to create a scene with altered physics for further exploration.
blocks.zh:
勘探记录还可以告知LLMs在随后的场景中调查的内容.
我们研究成功探索过程中纠正的错误是否能够指导新的发现挑战的产生、完善和构成。
每次行动都会修改一个涉及同一错误的机制,以创建一个物理改变的场景供进一步探索.

blocks.en:
We review successful GPT-6-Astra explorations for explanations corrected after later observations.
In Scene 15, red stops after a push, prompting the inference that no persistent northward force exists.
When red restarts, the explorer revises this explanation to account for a temporary pause in the force.
The designer receives this error, its correction, and the source laws, and uses the same evidence for all three operations.
Tab. 5 shows how the three designs retain the pause while modifying these laws.
blocks.zh:
我们审查成功的GPT-6-Astra探索情况,以在后来的观察之后纠正解释。
在15号场景中,红色在经过一次推力后停止,促使人们推断不存在持久的向北推进的力量.
当红色重启时,探险家会修改这个解释,以说明部队的临时暂停.
设计者收到这个错误,它的校正,以及源定律,并且对所有三个操作都使用同样的证据.
Tab. 5显示了三种设计在修改这些定律时如何保留暂停.

blocks.en:
Generation. The designer replaces the fixed northward force on red with mutual repulsion between red and blue, making the force depend on their relative positions.
Swapping their positions at matched times after a launch should reverse the forces, distinguishing repulsion from a fixed directional force.
blocks.zh:
历代. 设计师在红色上取代固定的北上部队,在红色和蓝色之间相互反弹,使部队依赖于其相对位置.
在发射后相应时间对其阵地进行扫荡应使部队反转,将反击与固定方向部队区分开来。

blocks.en:
Refinement. The designer introduces a spatial condition blocking red’s northward force while blue is inside the gray square, so waiting longer than ten seconds may still not restore it.
After the pause expires, the planned test moves blue by hand into or out of the square without resetting the timer.
blocks.zh:
精进精进. 设计者引入了一个空间条件,在蓝色位于灰色广场内时屏蔽红色的北向力,因此等待时间超过10秒仍可能无法恢复.
暂停期满后,计划中的测试会在不重设计时器的情况下,用手将蓝色移动进或出广场.

blocks.en:
Composition. The designer combines the paused northward force with Scene 14’s delayed motion copying: green takes red’s launch velocity twelve seconds later.
The planned comparison launches blue after red, postponing red’s force recovery while leaving green’s scheduled velocity copy unchanged.
The explorer must identify both altered physical laws and their distinct triggers and timing.
blocks.zh:
组成. 设计师将暂停的北向力与第14场延迟的动作复制相结合:绿色在12秒后取走红色的发射速度.
计划对比的发射是蓝色的,
探险者必须既确定经修改的物理定律,又明确其触发因素和时机。

blocks.en: Table 5: Scene evolution guided by a corrected error in Scene 15, with altered physical laws in three new scenes.
blocks.zh: 表5:场景演化在场景15中更正错误的指引下,三个新场景中物理定律有所改变.

blocks.en: Table 6: Discovery rates in source and evolved scenes.
blocks.zh: 表6:来源和演化场景中的发现率.

blocks.en: We evaluate GPT-6-Astra on source and evolved scenes using the free-exploration settings in Tab. 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们用Tab中的自由探索设置来评价GPT-6-Astra的源头和演化的场景. 页:1

blocks.en:
Tab. 6 reports discovery rates of 33.3% in Scene 15 and 66.7% in Scene 14, compared with 0% in all three evolved scenes.
Evidence support remains at 100%, but no evolved-scene report passes law correctness.
In the generated scene, an exploration identifies position-dependent repulsion without recovering its pause and delay.
In the refined scene, the explorer observes northward motion without linking it to blue’s position.
In the composed scene, it records red’s drift and green’s intermittent motion without identifying the two timing rules.
These cases use a corrected error to guide scene evolution, revealing unresolved conditions and dependencies in otherwise supported findings.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 6报告,第15幕的发现率为33.3%,第14幕的发现率为66.7%,而所有三个演化场景的发现率为0%.
证据支持率仍为100%,但任何演进的场景报告都没有通过正确性。
在生成的场景中,一次探索确定了依赖位置的厌恶,而没有恢复其暂停和延迟.
在精细的场景中,探险家观察着向北移动,而没有将其与蓝色的位置联系起来.
记录红色漂流和绿色间歇运动,
这些案件使用经更正的错误来指导场景演化,揭示了本可支持的调查结果中未解决的条件和依赖性.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
LongChang examines whether LLMs can turn unexpected observations into research questions and discover altered physical laws through experiments.
The evaluated LLMs manipulate objects and build tools without research tasks or hints about these laws.
Only one of the twelve evaluated LLMs makes discoveries, revealing the difficulty of turning observations into complete, experimentally supported laws.
Unanswered questions and corrected errors in exploration records guide separate LLM agents to evolve scenes, continuing the discovery cycle without human intervention.
This framework supports research into LLMs that decide what to investigate and design experiments to resolve uncertainties about the physical laws of these worlds.
blocks.zh:
长昌考察LLMS能否将意想不到的观测转化为研究问题,并通过实验发现改变的物理定律.
被评价的LLMS操纵对象和构建工具而无需研究任务或暗示这些定律.
12个受评价的法学硕士中只有1个进行了发现,揭示了将观测转化为完整、实验性支持的法律的困难。
未回答的问题和纠正的勘探记录错误引导单独的LLM剂进化场景,在没有人类干预的情况下继续发现周期.
这个框架支持研究LLMs,这些LLMs决定如何调查和设计实验,以解决这些世界物理定律的不确定性.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en:
This study examines whether LLMs initiate investigations and discover altered physical laws in simulated worlds.
Our results show that this task remains challenging for current LLMs.
The altered physical laws provide a clear basis for evaluating discoveries, while many scientific questions in the real world remain unresolved.
Extending the framework to these open questions requires further research on evaluating exploration and its findings in settings where the answers are not yet established.
blocks.zh:
本研究研究了LLMs是否在模拟世界中启动调查并发现物理定律的变化.
我们的结果表明,这项任务对目前的法学硕士课程仍然具有挑战性。
物理法的改变为评价发现提供了明确的基础,而现实世界的许多科学问题仍未得到解决。
将框架扩大到这些未决问题,需要进一步研究在尚未确定答案的情况下评估勘探及其结果。

blocks.en: 8 Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 8 道德考虑

blocks.en:
LongChang uses no human annotation or testing and evaluates LLMs without human intervention.
The evaluation therefore raises no ethical concerns related to participant privacy or informed consent.
blocks.zh:
长 Chang没有使用人类的注释或测试,在没有人类干预的情况下评价LLMS.
因此,评价没有引起与参与者隐私或知情同意有关的道德问题。

blocks.en: Appendix A Appendix
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: A.1 Scene Laws
blocks.zh: A.1 场景法

blocks.en:
Scene 01 provides the normal control: three movable balls and a decorative gray tile in a room with ordinary rigid-body physics.
Motion follows 𝐅 = m ​ 𝐚 \mathbf{F}=m\mathbf{a} and 𝐩 = m ​ 𝐯 \mathbf{p}=m\mathbf{v} , with constant downward gravitational acceleration independent of mass.
Contact with other objects, the floor, and walls produces collisions and friction.
Object colors remain fixed, and the gray tile has no physical effect on motion.
blocks.zh:
第01场景提供了正常的控制:三个可移动球和一个带有普通刚体物理的室内装饰灰色瓦片.

blocks.en:
We used AI assistants to improve the wording and clarity of the manuscript and to assist with code implementation and debugging.
We also used GPT-6.1-Sol as an automated judge to assess the correctness and experimental support of exploration reports, as described in Sec. 3.3 .
The authors are responsible for the manuscript, code, and findings.

blocks.en: A.5 Potential Risks
blocks.zh: A.5 潜在风险

blocks.en:
LLM judges may endorse unsupported findings and mislead subsequent research.
Our experiments are simulated, but physical use of generated experiments or apparatus could cause harm without independent validation and expert safety review.
Repeated LLM inference and simulation also consume energy, with associated environmental costs.
blocks.zh:
LLM法官可能认可无根据的调查结果并误导随后的研究。
我们的实验是模拟的,但是不进行独立验证和专家安全审查,实际使用产生的实验或仪器可能造成伤害.
重复的LLM推论和模拟也消耗能量,并附带环境成本.
